controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : le reglement europeen sur l'IA est entre en vigueur en aout 2024 ; risque de reproduction non autorisee d'oeuvres pour entrainer des modeles d'IA, imitations frauduleuses de la voix et de l'image des artistes ; risque que des artistes monetisent leur NIL avec des tiers plutot qu'avec UMG ; risque cote Likelihood High / Impact High
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 p.95-96 : "the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (the EU AI Act) entered into force in August 2024" ; "The unauthorised reproduction of copyrighted works, including music and lyrics, to train AI technology [...] embodies unauthorised and/or fraudulent renditions of artist voices, images and likenesses" ; "there is a risk that artists will work with third parties using AI to monetise those rights rather than through UMG" ; tableau Risk factors p.90 : "Generative AI | High | High"

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire/gouvernance : accord de relation du 8 septembre 2021 contenant un pacte de vote ; Vivendi 43,4% des voix / 13,43% du capital, V. Bollore 39,9% / 18,51%, Tencent 39,9% / 11,45% ; pas d'action a droit de vote double ni de preference
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 p.80 : "On September 8, 2021, Vivendi SE, Concerto Investment B.V. [...] entered into a relationship agreement" ; tableau AFM : Vivendi SE 13.43% / 43.38%, V. Bollore 18.51% / 39.90%, Tencent Holdings 11.45% / 39.90% ; note 3 "Each of Tencent Holdings Limited, Vivendi SE and V. Bollore has notified an aggregated percentage of voting rights in the Company based on a voting agreement included in the Relationship Agreement" ; "All Shares rank pari passu with each other"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance mineure : V. Bollore detient 18,51% du capital, la formule "aucun ne detient plus de 18,5%" est fausse de 0,01 pt. Ecrire "aucun ne detient plus de 19% du capital".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : resultat net part du groupe de 1 432 M EUR a 222 M EUR (-84%), baisse de 1 210 M EUR, dont -1 572 M EUR de reevaluation Spotify/TME et -1 608 M EUR sur le resultat financier ; resultat operationnel -46 M EUR ; resultat net ajuste -19 M EUR soit -2,2%
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Financial Review H1 2026 p.5 : "Net profit attributable to equity holders of the parent decreased by EUR1,210 million, reflecting: the decline in operating profit (-EUR46 million) [...] the decline in financial income and financial expenses (-EUR1,608 million) driven by the unfavourable variance in the revaluation of the investments in listed and other companies including Spotify and Tencent Music Entertainment (-EUR1,572 million)" ; "Adjusted net profit in the first half of 2026 amounted to a profit of EUR863 million a decrease of EUR19 million or 2.2%"

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : Free Cash Flow 24 M EUR au S1 2026 contre 163 M EUR au S1 2025 (base retraitee), -85% ; rachats d'actions 734 M EUR + dividende final 514 M EUR = 1 248 M EUR ; emprunts nets 1 712 M EUR contre 594 M EUR ; dette financiere nette 2 390 -> 4 131 M EUR (+73%)
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Financial Review H1 2026 : "Free Cash Flow in the first half of 2026 was a EUR24 million net inflow compared to a EUR163 million" (tableau : 24 vs 163, HY25 restated) ; "UMG's repurchase of its own shares for EUR734 million ; Payment of the final dividend with respect to fiscal year 2025 of EUR514 million" ; "the increase in net proceeds from borrowings in the first 6 months of 2026 of EUR1,712 million compared to a net proceeds from borrowings of EUR594 million" ; tableau Financial Net Debt : (4,131) vs (2,390)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : les 1 712 M EUR sont un montant NET (6 188 M EUR d'emprunts leves moins 4 476 M EUR de remboursements), pas des "emprunts nouveaux contractes" bruts. Ecrire "1 712 M EUR d'endettement net supplementaire leve".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : Downtown Music a apporte 288 M EUR de CA et 0 M EUR de resultat avant impot ; 580 M EUR de goodwill pour 41 M EUR d'actifs nets identifiables ; allocation du prix provisoire
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Financial Review H1 2026, Note 4 : "From the acquisition date, Downtown contributed EUR288 million of revenue and EUR0 million to profit before income taxes of the Group" ; "Downtown identifiable net assets on acquisition date 41 / Goodwill arising on the Downtown business combination 580 / Purchase consideration transferred 621" ; "UMG is continuing to review the fair values of Downtown's acquisition date assets and liabilities in order to complete the accounting for the business combination"

controles.affirmation: Concentration : les 50 premiers services musicaux = 97% du CA numerique de la musique enregistree ; 70% du CA de la musique enregistree vient du numerique ; accords de duree relativement courte sans garantie de renouvellement aux memes conditions
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 p.90-91 : "For the year ended December 31, 2025, the top 50 music services accounted for 97% of UMG's recorded music digital revenue" ; "For the year ended December 31, 2025, 70% of UMG's recorded music revenue was derived from digital channels" ; "UMG typically enters into relatively short-term agreements with digital music streaming services. There can be no assurance that UMG will be able to renew agreements on the same terms"

controles.affirmation: Marge d'EBITDA ajuste 21,1% au S1 2026 contre 22,7% au S1 2025 (-1,6 pt) alors que le CA progresse de 5,3% (+10,8% a change constant)
controles.verbatim_source: Interim Financial Review H1 2026 p.4 : "Adjusted EBITDA margin decreased by 1.6pp to 21.1% in the first 6 months of 2026 from 22.7% in the first 6 months of 2025 driven by the consolidation of Downtown, pressure from revenue and repertoire mix in Recorded Music, and a loss in Merchandising" ; "Revenues for the first half of 2026 were EUR6,194 million, up 5.3% compared to the first half of 2025 and up 10.8% at constant currency"
